notes: Independently verified: issue body contains both log lines verbatim plus the effect sentence (wrong motion: controller keeps following the last path). Maintainer comment (fetched by id 2327562456) is verbatim, including "If you have a server timeout of 10ms and you've just started a planning request that is 100ms in length, then it won't always cancel in time."; the reporter's reply (fetched by id 2340126891) confirms "Our `server_timeout` is currently set to 100ms.". Second user (fetched by id 2607122040): "Increasing `default_server_timeout` from 30 to even ~50ms solves this issue." on Jazzy with a coverage-navigator BT — a different peer/distro, correctly used as recommended-evidence. PR #5895 "Add cancel timeout when cancelling actions" is MERGED, closes #4659, labelled backport-jazzy/kilted, approved by SteveMacenski. Eligibility: bt_navigator and controller_server are two nodes interacting only through the follow_path action (separate units per S1 even though one repo); the failure is response latency vs the client's timeout crossing the action boundary — stop_step 6 with action interface is right; the fix adds a cancel_timeout parameter, not a name binding. Both conditions class `other` is right (no listed class covers server-response latency vs client wait; qos_deadline is a DDS policy, rate_shortfall a publication rate). The compute_path_to_pose/planner_server failure is a different composition and is correctly confined to notes.
